title: Cozi Family Calendar Conflict Density
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cozi:event conflict_count>0
bin _time span=1w
stats sum(conflict_count) as conflicts by _time
description: Counts weekly Cozi calendar scheduling conflicts.
value: Surfacing cozi family calendar conflict density helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant family, baby & household chaos export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It builds when cozi family calendar conflict density matters for your routine.
